analysis.percentage_definition: 100*(1-mean candidate MSE/mean reference MSE); clipped-float MSE = 10**(-PSNR/10)
analysis.aggregation: average noise repeats within each original photograph, then equal photograph weights; both datasets and every location separately
analysis.scope: descriptive convenience web collection; related scenes/authors; not independent benchmark sampling or self-capture
analysis.no_test_selection: catalog, preprocessing and checkpoint hashes locked before inference; no training or checkpoint selection uses these photographs
analysis.original_pretraining_exposure: not fully audited for publicly available imagery

baseline.aggregation: noise repeats within image, then images within sequence, then equal sequence weights within dataset; Kodak units are individual images

conclusion: At clean 10% sampling, the 10000-step state reduces mean MSE by +1.73% on campus, +1.91% on scenic versus the 100-step state. The 5% minimum is not met on both subsets.
